title: Task Context v1 result envelope
description: Frozen result envelope shape (Issue #2563 AC8). `data` internals are additive/open per-operation and are NOT constrained by this schema. `status`/`code` are the business-result semantics and are deliberately independent of the CLI process exit code.

code.description: Business result code, e.g. OK, VALIDATION_ERROR, TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE, CONFLICT, NOT_FOUND, CORRUPT_DATABASE, SCHEMA_TOO_NEW, INTERNAL_ERROR. See error-taxonomy.md.

data.description: Operation-specific fields. Intentionally open -- future consumer children add fields additively without changing this envelope.
